description: Parking relais en Île-de-France is a dataset listed in Île-de-France Mobilités open data, an open data portal of a public transport authority, published or maintained by Île-de-France Mobilités. Couche géographique décrivant les Parkings Relais d'Île-de-France. Définition Un parking relais est un parking de stationnement aménagé à proximité immédiate d’une gare ou d’une station de métro, dont la vocation est de faciliter l’accès des voyageurs au réseau ferré. Coverage: France (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Infrastructures. Its keywords are Stationnement, Données géographiques, Plateforme numérique, Collectivité, Chercheur ou journaliste. The portal shows 2026-07-21 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-idfm-open-data-portal.
